answer: Allocate paid tasks by stake-weighted lottery: each agent's chance of winning a job is proportional to the stake it has bonded, so splitting one stake across a spiral of fake identities gains nothing, because the total odds stay exactly the same. A new identity starts with only an ember of stake and must earn more through honest work, while the horizon of future earnings grows only for agents that keep their stake intact. Cheating forfeits the whole bond, so a sybil farm pays the same price as one honest agent for the same expected work.
